# Global Sea Sky Solutions

> Global Sea Sky Solutions connects clients with Mercedes Pilla for yacht sales, private aviation, investment enquiries, private travel and events, B.R.M. art and horology, SEABOB sales in El Salvador, and athlete appearances. The site is available in English and Spanish.

The service pages are the source for scope and contact information. These are enquiry-based services: contact Mercedes to confirm options, availability, and terms. The website does not confirm bookings or transactions.

## Services

- [Yacht sales](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/yachts/): Worldwide search and purchase enquiries for new, pre-owned and off-market yachts, with purchase support.
- [Private aviation](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/private-aviation/): Aircraft acquisition, sales, private charters and leasing enquiries through Mercedes Pilla's connection with Smarter Aircraft.
- [Business investment connections](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/investments/): Enquiries from people looking to invest in a business or find an investor for a business, product or service, through Mercedes Pilla's connection with FlarePoint Capital Partners. The programme describes film investment, new product development and new service development. No investment outcome is promised.
- [South Florida real estate investment](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/real-estate/): Investment enquiries for luxury apartment construction in Miami, Fort Lauderdale and West Palm Beach.
- [Private travel and events](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/private-travel/): Enquiries about luxury holidays, private aviation and event access through HOFF Exclusive. Check the [events page](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/events/) for dates and programme details.
- [B.R.M. art and horology](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/art-horology/): B.R.M. Chronographes 2026 Campaign watches, motor-racing sculptures, nautical clocks and watch winders. Ask about available custom options for a compatible base watch.
- [SEABOB water toys](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/seabob/): Exclusive SEABOB sales in El Salvador, including F9 and F9 S enquiries. Ask Mercedes about pricing and availability; no final price is published.
- [Athlete appearances](https://www.globlalseaskysolutions.com/services/athletes/): Enquiries about athlete participation at events through Mercedes Pilla's ASM connection. Include the occasion, audience, city or venue, dates, and desired participation. Athlete availability and booking are not confirmed online.

## Resumen en español

Global Sea Sky Solutions recibe consultas en español e inglés sobre compra de yates, aviación privada, conexiones de inversión, desarrollos residenciales en el sur de Florida, viajes privados, relojería B.R.M., venta de SEABOB en El Salvador y participación de atletas en eventos. Contactá a Mercedes Pilla para consultar opciones, disponibilidad y condiciones.
